tokens.styling: Tailwind utility classes + shadcn/ui theme tokens (CSS variables); one accent + neutral ramp
tokens.components_source: shadcn/ui — copy components into the repo (not a dependency) and theme via tokens
tokens.spacing: Tailwind spacing scale on a 4px grid

components.name: Button
components.when_to_use: one primary action per view; use variant/size props

components.name: Input
components.when_to_use: text fields; pair with <Label> and form state

components.name: Card
components.when_to_use: grouped content — but avoid the generic three-identical-cards hero

rules: Function components and hooks only; compose shadcn/ui primitives rather than hand-rolling raw Tailwind.
Theme through the design tokens (CSS variables), not ad-hoc color values.
Handle loading, empty, and error states explicitly — never a blank screen.
Follow the ui-ux-foundations rubric: hierarchy, AA contrast, visible focus, and none of the AI-slop tells.
